text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aw, you've got paperwork to do after
this? You
sure you're not overworking
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can dig myself out of
this... I'm
sunk! How could I have messed
up this badly?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh. You might be fine, but there's
someone
here who sure isn't.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, so you made a typo on the order
form,
huh? Yeah, selling a thousand
cartons of milk in a
day's gonna be
rough...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But what if you actually manage to do
it? That's a
lot of money right there! This
little mistake might
lead to some mad
profits!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'm here to help, so no worries!
You
always give me freebies when I shop
here, so this
is my chance to pay you
back! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ryan! Perfect timing! How about
some milk?
Didn't you say the carton
you were using for your
protein powder
ran out?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you remembered that? You're
incredible,
Palmer... I was just thinking I
had to grab another
carton or two!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I can buy in bulk, right? In that case, I'll
take ten
cartons, please!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I want some milk too! I gotta fuel up so I
can keep
zooming!
choice_data_list: す、すぐお持ちしまーす！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Careful not to drink too much, or else
you'll get a
stomachache! The daily
recommended amount is
about a cup of
milk a day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Milk is full of protein, calcium, and a
bunch of
other nutrients! You can't ask
for a better
everyday drink!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that's amazing! Milk sure makes
keeping
healthy a breeze!

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, drinking milk has so many
great
benefits! I should get some for my
little one.
Excuse me, I'd like three
cartons, please!

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
Three for me, too!
I'll take five, please!

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Palmer! We all came to help out! We'd
each like
three cartons, please!
choice_data_list: （うおおお、また補充しないと……！）
（うわああ、また補充しないと……！）

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you came just for me?! That's so
sweet of
you all! All right, how many of
you are there?
One, two, three, four...

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Can you make a run to get more from
the back,
Trainer? We've got to keep
the shelves stocked!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Milk cartons fly off the shelves almost as
fast as
we can restock them thanks to
Mejiro Palmer's
help, but then...

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, it's starting to rain! Hey! Let's get
all the
displays outside under the
awning!

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Achoo! Ugh... The temperature dropped
so
suddenly... I really can't catch a
break...

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for everything, you two. You
really helped
me out of a jam.
choice_data_list: 売れ行きに影響しそうですね……

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
I'd hate to see the rest of the milk go to
waste,
but I'll have no choice but to
dispose of it all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oof, talk about crummy weather...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, things sure look bad, but! This is
might be
our big break!
choice_data_list_en: That's definitely gonna be tough, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yep! And we can't let it slip us by!
Hey,
is it okay if I borrow a few things? I'll
need a
big pot, some sugar...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, there! Can I interest you in some
hot milk? A
sip of this will warm you
right up!

text_block_list.name: Shopper A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a warm drink on a cold day like
this? I'll
take a cup, please!

text_block_list.name: Shopper B
text_block_list.text:
The rain came out of nowhere, but you
guys sure
are prepared! That's some
business acumen right
there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! That's the last of it!
Which
means...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: We sold out! Waheeey!

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
You seriously saved me and my business!
How
could I possibly thank you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it! The milk got sold, I
got to
help you out, and everyone's
happy! That's good
enough for me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it! The milk got sold, I
got to
help you out, and everyone's
happy! That's good
enough for me!
choice_data_list_en: You really are the ultimate salesclerk...!
You really are the ultimate salesclerk...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You're the bestest ever, Trainer! It was a
blast
working alongside you!
choice_data_list_en: You really are the ultimate salesclerk...!
You really are the ultimate salesclerk...!

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
I really appreciate your aid as well.
Thanks for
agreeing to help, despite
your busy work
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Pfft! Lay it on as thick as you'd like,
Trainer! You
won't get anything out of
me other than a smile,
though!

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
I really appreciate your aid as well.
Thanks for
agreeing to help, despite
your busy work
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Work... Work? Aaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Omigosh, you had paperwork left to do,
didn't
you?! I totes forgot because I was
so preoccupied
with our milk dilemma!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I mean... Knowing you, I'm sure you
really
mean that, but still...
choice_data_list: 仕事なんていつでもできるよ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm seriously sorry! This won't happen
again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer looks wilted and deflated
from
guilt, a huge difference from her
usual energetic
and chipper self.
